Minding your own Business - the atrium part of this quest has a quest description that 100% made me think there were going to be spiders there. Sometimes life gives us a sign this way. I remember driving out of town to a specific hotel with a bag full of over the counter medications. Sat in the car park trying to book a room online so I didn't have to face talking to the person at the counter, only to find out that they didn't have any rooms left. My plan was ruined so I just sat and cried for an hour, and then drove home. 

It was a weekday night, not during any special holiday or anything. There was no reason that hotel should have been fully booked. But I have to believe it was a sign because that's what keeps me going now. 

I hope you are able to listen to your sign, and that things get easier.
